quote: The "Mirasol" project began construction on January 20, 2023, of a solar power plant located in the province of Santo Domingo in the Dominican Republic, with an installed capacity of 127 MW (100 MW nominal). This plant has been operational since February 2025. 100% of the plant's generation is delivered to a single customer, EDE Este.
note: Opened AES España IFRS 2025 English PDF (Mirasol COD Feb 2025; 100 MW nominal).
